verdict.rationale: Postmark's own docs describe webhooks for real-time event notifications. They list dedicated Delivery and Bounce webhook pages and cover receiver security: HTTP Basic Auth, IP allowlisting, payload validation and idempotency. Most of this evidence is page titles or summaries rather than in-depth content. missing for 10: an evidenced full list of subscribable event types beyond delivery/bounce, explicit documentation of a webhook registration API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Node/TypeScript HTTP Basic Authentication, IP allowlisting, payload shape validation, event parsing, Express route setup, and idempotency pattern
